correctness.rationale: Writing each monic quadratic uniquely f=(X−a)^2+b, Capelli norm reduction makes three consecutive irreducibility tests exactly χ(−b)=χ(f(b))=χ(f²(b))=−1. In bijective coordinates (t=b−a,x=b), the relevant values are x,x+t²,x+t²(t+1)². The character product indicator has exactly one spurious zero at (t,x)=(0,0); complete x,t quadratic pair sums are 0,q,q and cubic triple sum 1+χ(−1). Expansion yields N1=q(q−1)/2, N2=(q²−1)/4, N3=(q−1)(q+2+χ(−1))/8 for every odd prime power. Independent enumerations checked all p² coefficient choices for p=3,5,7,11,13,17,19 and all pair/triple character correlations.
